topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: I figured it out today, the truth about Mr. Thompson. Behind his worn coat and faded smile, he harbors a secret—I've seen the glint in his eyes, the subtle, unnecessary gestures of a man who doesn’t truly live the life he pretends. His garden, so meticulously kept, a facade of simple pleasures. I imagine the rooms beyond the neatly curtained windows, a world I’ve never glimpsed. It feels like a story I’m only allowed to watch from the outside, a play where I’m not invited to join in. The quiet of the evening seems heavier now, the stars in the sky less welcoming.
